name: Smith Machine Reverse-Grip Bent-Over Row
steps: Face the Smith bar and grip it underhand with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Release the hooks, soften your knees and hinge forward until the bar hangs under your shoulders.
Pull the bar smoothly upward toward your lower abdomen while keeping your elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension while holding your torso angle steady.
tips: Avoid jerking your torso upright to assist heavier weights.
Squeeze your lats and lower shoulder blades back cleanly at the top of each repetition.
